source: Public 2. OG resident-aligned top-floor study before conditional area-led refit, 2026-11-15. Exterior, confirmed relative constraints, room counts and window observations remain the reference.

level.label: 2. OG — resident-aligned study
level.source: Resident-confirmed matching W4/L1 corner overlap and 1/4 L3-side : 3/4 R1-side stair alignment, clarified 15 November 2026; prior window marks and unchanged Bavarian exterior.
level.notes: The L block now matches W4’s confirmed corner overlap. The marked exterior edge extends through the staircase with 1/4 toward L3 and 3/4 toward R1. L bay widths are retained; the stair enclosure is derived at about 1.78m gross. These relative observations do not measure room sizes, clear stair width, masonry or landing depths. Twenty rooms and 24 windows remain; exact openings and dimensions are estimates. R’s dimensional fit and the east stairwell entrance remain unresolved.

spaces.label: Stairwell — resident correction
spaces.note: The resident confirms that the extended marked outside edge splits the staircase: 1/4 toward L3 and 3/4 toward R1. Both sides run parallel to that source edge, so the ratio holds throughout the flight. Matching L1 to W4's corner overlap while retaining the estimated L bays derives a 1.781m gross enclosure. This is not a measured clear stair width. Flight length and landing depths remain schematic. The west-hall entrance is retained; the east-hall connection remains unknown.
